### [180] [Not What, But How: A Communicative Audit of LLM Response Framing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02493)
*Siddhesh Milind Pawar,Sarah Masud,Haneul Yoo,Alice Oh,Isabelle Augenstein*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出FRANZ框架，从文化定位、概括性语言、拟人化线索和对话准则四个维度审计LLM对主观问题的回应特征，并构建了包含37.6万条主观问题的SQUARE语料库。实验发现LLMs在这些维度上存在显著统计差异，且内部视角和拟人化呈正相关，耦合程度因国家而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估主要关注事实正确性，忽视了回应方式（如语气、文化定位等）对用户体验的影响，尤其是在主观性、信息寻求型问题中。

Method: 构建FRANZ自动化框架，定义四维评估指标；创建SQUARE语料库（37.6万条主观问题，来源57个子版块，映射到7个国家和19个类别）；对三个开源LLM进行评分分析。

Result: LLMs在四个维度的使用频率上存在显著统计差异；内部视角定位与拟人化呈正相关，且耦合程度因国家而异。

Conclusion: FRANZ提供了比单一维度审计更丰富的诊断视角，能有效识别LLM回应在跨文化框架上的差异。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are being increasingly used to answer subjective, information-seeking questions, where users are sensitive to how responses are communicated, not just whether the answers are correct. Existing LLM evaluations for subjective cultural queries largely focus on factual correctness, ignoring how the response is framed. To this end, we introduce FRANZ, an automated FRAmework for respoNse characteriZation to conduct communicative audit of LLM responses along four dimensions: cultural positioning, use of generalizing language, anthropomorphic cues, and adherence to conversational maxims. To enable this evaluation, we contribute SQUARE - a corpus of 376k subjective questions sourced from 57 subreddits, and mapped to 7 countries and 19 question categories. We demonstrate FRANZ's applicability by scoring responses from three open-weight LLMs. We observe that LLMs show statistically significant differences in the frequency with which they employ each response characteristic. Unlike single-dimensional audits, FRANZ reveals that insider positioning and anthropomorphism are positively coupled, with the degree of coupling varying by country, providing a diagnostic lens for identifying framing divergences.

</details>


### [181] [CRAM: Centroid-Routing and Adaptive MoE for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02502)
*Jun-Tao Tang,Zhen-Hao Xie,Yu-Cheng Shi,Da-Wei Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CRAM方法，通过独立模块缓解灾难性遗忘、自适应秩实例化提升参数效率、质心引导路由实现专家能力复用，解决多模态持续指令微调中任务竞争与参数效率的困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在持续能力扩展中面临两难：共享参数更新导致异构任务竞争和灾难性遗忘，而独立扩展模块虽避免干扰但严重限制参数效率，亟需一种兼顾抗遗忘与参数高效的方法。

Method: 1) 将任务特定模式隔离为独立模块缓解遗忘；2) 自适应秩实例化动态识别已有能力与新任务需求之间的差距，仅分配必要参数；3) 质心引导路由识别并激活已有专家能力，正交性惩罚约束新更新沿任务特定方向进行，防止重新学习通用能力。

Result: 在多个多样化基准上一致优于现有方法。

Conclusion: CRAM通过动态参数分配与路由机制有效平衡了持续微调中的抗遗忘与参数效率。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) unify heterogeneous vision-language tasks under a shared generative framework via instruction tuning, yet real-world deployment demands continuous capability expansion, making Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) essential. Existing methods either update all tasks with a shared parameter set or allocate dedicated modules for each new task. Shared updates force heterogeneous tasks to compete, causing forgetting of learned capabilities. Conversely, isolated expansion prevents interference but severely limits parameter efficiency over long task streams. To address this dilemma, we propose CRAM. Specifically, by isolating task-specific patterns into independent modules, CRAM mitigates catastrophic forgetting across tasks. To further boost parameter efficiency, we utilize adaptive-rank instantiation to identify the capability gap between existing expert capability and new task demands, and dynamically allocate only the necessary parameters. To ensure stable reuse among tasks, centroid-guided routing recognizes and activates existing experts' capabilities, while an orthogonality penalty confines new updates to task-specific directions, preventing re-learning general capability. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks consistently demonstrate its superiority over existing methods.

</details>


### [182] [When Rating Scales Fall Short: LLM-Assisted Discovery of ADHD Signals in Turkish Teacher Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02509)
*Baris Karacan,Irem Aktar Songur,Ahmet Ozaslan,Elvan Iseri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究分析土耳其语教师评语（CTRS-R:S量表分数+开放式叙事文本），发现结构化评估与教师叙事文本编码互补信号，叙事文本能捕捉到量表遗漏的注意、行为和家庭相关模式，LLM辅助的主题发现管道揭示了这些差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究教师开放式叙事文本是否包含结构化评定量表（CTRS-R:S）所忽视的ADHD相关信号，以及两种信息源之间的互补性。

Method: 收集土耳其语教师评估表（含CTRS-R:S分数和开放式叙事文本），比较结构化分数与叙事文本的预测信号；对结构化评估无法清晰区分ADHD与非ADHD的案例，使用LLM辅助的主题发现管道分析叙事文本中的行为模式。

Result: 结构化评估与叙事模型各自遗漏的案例重叠度极低，表明两者编码互补信号；叙事文本捕捉到注意、行为和家庭相关的独特模式。

Conclusion: 教师叙事文本包含结构化量表无法捕获的临床相关信号，NLP技术可辅助传统ADHD筛查工具，提升诊断全面性。

Abstract: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is one of the most common neurodevelopmental disorders in childhood, and its diagnosis relies on assessments combining clinician judgment with standardized rating scales and reports from parents and teachers. While structured instruments such as the Conners' Teacher Rating Scale-Revised Short Form (CTRS-R:S) quantify ADHD-related behaviors, teachers also provide open-ended narratives that may contain complementary signals not captured by structured assessments. However, it remains unclear to what extent teacher narratives encode signals overlooked by rating scales. In this study, we analyze de-identified Turkish teacher evaluation forms collected during clinical ADHD assessments, including both CTRS-R:S scores and open-ended teacher narratives. We compare predictive signals from structured scores and narrative text and identify cases where structured assessments fail to clearly distinguish ADHD from non-ADHD students while narrative-based models capture distinct behavioral patterns. Notably, these cases show minimal overlap with those missed by the narrative model, suggesting that structured and narrative information encode complementary signals. To interpret these differences, we apply a large language model (LLM)-assisted theme discovery pipeline that reveals distinct attention, behavioral, and family-related patterns, highlighting the potential of natural language processing (NLP) to uncover clinically relevant signals from teacher narratives and to complement traditional ADHD screening tools.

</details>


### [183] [FigSIM: A Dataset for Fine-grained Suicide Severity and Figurative Language in Suicide Memes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02523)
*Liuliu Chen,Elise R. Carrotte,Brian E. Chapman,Jo Robinson,Mike Conway*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了FigSIM，首个面向自杀迷因细粒度分析的数据集，包含1049个标注样本，覆盖自杀严重程度、比喻现象和自杀相关内容三个维度，并基准测试了16个模型，揭示了自杀迷因在建模和内容审核中的独特挑战与偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自杀迷因在社交媒体上日益常见，但其特征尚未被充分理解，且可能具有危害性。当前缺乏标注数据集，阻碍了自动化内容审核方法的发展与评估。

Method: 构建了FigSIM数据集，包含1049个自杀迷因样本，每个样本进行了三方面细粒度标注：(1)自杀严重程度等级；(2)比喻现象（如隐喻）；(3)自杀相关内容（如自杀方式描绘）。并在此数据集上对16个单模态和多模态模型进行了基准测试。

Result: FigSIM表明自杀迷因对建模和内容审核构成独特挑战。分析发现模型存在偏见，尤其是在对较高自杀严重程度等级的预测不足问题上，对含比喻表达的自杀迷因更为明显。

Conclusion: FigSIM数据集为自杀迷因的自动审核研究提供了基础资源，揭示了当前模型在处理这一特殊内容时的局限性与偏见，呼吁进一步发展更有效的内容审核策略。

Abstract: Suicide memes are memes used to express suicide-related thoughts or comment on suicide-related issues. Suicide memes are increasingly common on social media, yet remain poorly understood and potentially harmful. There is an urgent need to better understand their characteristics and to develop appropriate content moderation strategies that limits users' exposure to potentially harmful content. Currently, the absence of annotated datasets of suicide memes remains a key barrier to developing and evaluating automated moderation approaches. In this paper, we introduce FigSIM, the first dataset designed for fine-grained analysis of suicide memes. The dataset consists of 1049 memes, each annotated for (1) fine-grained suicide severity levels, (2) figurative phenomena (e.g., metaphors), and (3) suicide-related content (e.g., suicide method depiction). We benchmark 16 unimodal and multimodal models across three tasks: figurative language, suicide severity, and suicide-related content detection. Overall, FigSIM demonstrates that suicide memes pose unique challenges for both modeling and content moderation. Analysis revealed biases, such as underprediction of higher suicide severity levels, especially for figurative memes. The dataset (including splits used for analyses) is publicly available. Content Warning: This paper contains suicide-related content that may be triggering.

</details>


### [184] [SkillHarm: Lifecycle-Aware Skill-Based Attacks via Automated Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02540)
*Yuting Ning,Zhehao Zhang,Yash Kumar Lal,Boyu Gou,Junyi Li,Weitong Ruan,Chentao Ye,Rahul Gupta,Diyi Yang,Yu Su,Huan Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 SkillHarm 基准，系统评估了技能生命周期中的两种投毒攻击（固定载荷投毒 FPP 和自变异投毒 SMP），涵盖 12 种风险类型，并通过自动化构建管道 AutoSkillHarm 生成 879 个攻击样本。实验表明当前智能体攻击成功率高达 86.3%（FPP）和 69.3%（SMP），且现有防御措施无法可靠缓解威胁。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究揭示了技能诱导的不安全智能体行为，但主要局限于单次任务执行中的毒化技能评估，并通过临时风险列表枚举危害，缺乏对技能使用全生命周期的系统化分析和标准化基准。

Method: 提出了 SkillHarm 基准，定义了两种攻击场景：固定载荷投毒（FPP）和自变异投毒（SMP）；定义了基于数据管道、系统环境和智能体自主性三类组件的 12 种风险类型；并构建了 AutoSkillHarm 自动化管道，使用编码智能体配合自然语言驱动生成攻击样本。

Result: 生成了包含 71 个技能、879 个攻击样本的基准。实验显示 FPP 攻击成功率达 86.3%，SMP 达 69.3%。分析发现许多攻击失败实际上是智能体未能触及毒化文件而非真正抵抗，现有防御措施无法可靠缓解威胁。

Conclusion: 当前智能体在面对技能投毒攻击时仍高度脆弱，需要更有效的防御机制；同时揭示了隐藏风险，即表面上的攻击失败可能掩盖了智能体未能与毒化文件交互的问题。

Abstract: Agent skills occupy a privileged position in the agent workflow, as agents are expected to implicitly follow and execute them, rendering third-party skills a vulnerable attack surface. Existing studies have revealed unsafe agent behaviors induced by skill-based attacks, but they primarily evaluate poisoned skills within a single task execution and enumerate harms through ad-hoc risk lists. To bridge these gaps, we introduce SkillHarm, a benchmark of skill-based attacks across the skill-use lifecycle, paired with a systematic taxonomy of skill-relevant risks. SkillHarm evaluates two attack scenarios: Fixed-Payload Poisoning (FPP), where a fixed poisoned skill package directly compromises any task session that invokes it, and Self-Mutating Poisoning (SMP), where an initially benign execution silently mutates persistent skill content, deferring harm until a subsequent reuse. It further defines 12 risk types based on the agent workflow component targeted by the harm: data pipelines, system environments, and agent autonomy. To instantiate these attacks at scale, we build AutoSkillHarm, an automated construction pipeline with coding agents driven by natural-language harnesses. The resulting benchmark contains 879 attack samples across 71 skills. Experiments show that current agents remain vulnerable with attack success rates up to 86.3% in FPP and 69.3% in SMP. Our analysis further reveals a latent risk: many apparent attack failures stem from the agent failing to engage with the poisoned file rather than genuine resistance, and current defenses still fail to reliably mitigate the threat.

</details>


### [185] [SimSD: Simple Speculative Decoding in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02544)
*Junxia Cui,Haotian Ye,Runchu Tian,Hongcan Guo,Jinya Jiang,Haoru Li,Chaojie Ren,Yiming Huang,Kaijie Zhu,Zhongkai Yu,Kun Zhou,Jingbo Shang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SimSD，一种针对扩散语言模型的投机性解码算法，通过即插即用的遮蔽策略赋予dLLM时间有效的token级上下文，实现单次前向传播中验证多个草稿token，在保持生成质量的同时最高提升7.46倍解码吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型(dLLM)虽然具备并行/块解码的推理加速优势，但其基于遮蔽语言建模的公式与标准token级投机性解码不兼容。AR模型的因果掩码保证了时间有效的token级上下文，而dLLM依赖遮蔽token和双向注意力，导致有效上下文在去噪步骤中变化，无法直接进行token级投机性验证。为弥合这一差距，亟需一种能让dLLM具备AR模型验证能力同时保留并行解码优势的投机解码算法。

Method: SimSD采用即插即用的遮蔽策略，显式引入来自草稿模型预测的参考token，并设计一种注意力掩码来调节它们与当前步骤token的交互，使dLLM能够在单次前向传播中为草稿token计算有效的logits。该方法无需训练，可灵活与KV缓存、块解码等其他加速技术集成。

Result: 在四个基准测试上对SDAR系列dLLM进行实验，结果表明SimSD在保持甚至提升平均生成质量的同时，实现了最高7.46倍的解码吞吐量提升。

Conclusion: SimSD成功弥合了dLLM与AR模型在投机性解码之间的差距，通过恢复AR模型中因果掩码的关键验证能力，同时保留dLLM的并行解码优势，为扩散语言模型提供了一种有效且无需训练的推理加速方案。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) LLMs, offering faster inference through parallel or blockwise decoding. However, their masked language modeling formulation remains incompatible with standard token-level speculative decoding, one of the most effective acceleration techniques for AR models. In AR decoding, the causal mask preserves temporally valid token-level contexts, enabling a target model to verify multiple drafted tokens in a single forward pass. In contrast, dLLMs rely on mask tokens and bidirectional attention, causing the effective context to change across denoising steps and preventing direct token-level speculative verification. To bridge this gap, we propose a simple but effective speculative decoding algorithm for diffusion language models, named SimSD, which mainly adopts a plug-and-play masking strategy that equips dLLMs with temporally valid token-level contexts for speculative decoding. Our method explicitly introduces reference tokens from draft-model predictions and designs an attention mask that regulates their interaction with current-step tokens, allowing dLLMs to compute valid logits for drafted tokens in a single forward pass. This restores the key verification ability provided by causal masking in AR models while preserving the parallel decoding advantages of dLLMs. The proposed method is training-free and can be flexibly integrated with other acceleration techniques such as KV cache and blockwise decoding. Experiments on SDAR-family dLLMs across four benchmarks show that our method achieves up to 7.46x higher decoding throughput while maintaining and even improving average generation quality.

</details>


### [186] [Transferable Self-Harm Surveillance from Emergency Department Triage Notes Using an Evidence-Augmented Machine Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02545)
*Liuliu Chen,Gowri Rajaram,Eleanor Bailey,Katrina Witt,Michelle Lamblin,Jo Robinson,Mike Conway,Vlada Rozova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种三阶段方法，结合传统机器学习和大型语言模型，从急诊科分诊记录中检测自伤行为。该方法在三个澳大利亚医院的数据上表现优异，AUPRC达到0.88以上，并能以95%的准确率识别自伤方式，支持更细粒度的监控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自伤是一个重大公共卫生问题，但当前依赖医院诊断编码的监测方式因编码灵敏度低而效果不佳。急诊科分诊记录作为初始接触点的摘要信息，为识别自伤提供了机会，因此需要开发更有效的检测方法。

Method: 开发了一种三阶段方法：在传统机器学习基础上，结合基于大型语言模型的筛查和证据提取，用于检测急诊科分诊记录中的自伤行为。在三个澳大利亚医院评估了模型的迁移性。

Result: 内部验证AUPRC为0.887±0.016，外部验证为0.884±0.012。前瞻性评估中，开发站点AUPRC为0.881±0.008，两个外部站点（无需站点特定再训练）分别为0.879±0.012和0.816±0.015。识别主要自伤方式的准确率达到95%。

Conclusion: 该方法不仅实现了高精度的自伤检测，还能以高准确率识别自伤方式，支持超出二元分类的更细粒度监控，具有良好的跨站点迁移性。

Abstract: Self-harm is a major public health concern, but current surveillance relying on hospital presentations is inadequate due to the low sensitivity of diagnostic codes. Emergency Department (ED) triage notes, recorded at the initial point of contact, provide a succinct summary of presentations and an opportunity to identify self-harm. We developed a three-stage approach, augmenting traditional machine learning with large language model-based screening and evidence extraction to detect self-harm in ED triage notes. We assessed model transferability across three Australian hospitals. Our approach showed AUPRCs of 0.887 +/- 0.016 and 0.884 +/- 0.012 during internal and external validation. Prospectively, it achieved AUPRC of 0.881 +/- 0.008 at the development site, and 0.879 +/- 0.012 and 0.816 +/- 0.015 at two external sites without site-specific retraining. A key advantage of the approach is that it enables identification of the primary self-harm method with an accuracy of 95%, supporting more granular surveillance beyond binary classification.

</details>


### [187] [SN-WER: Script-Normalized WER for Multi-Script Indic ASR Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02548)
*Priyaranjan Pattnayak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出脚本归一化WER（SN-WER），在评估前将参考文本和假设文本转写为标准文字，以消除ASR中因文字系统差异导致的错误高估。在5种印度语言上的实验表明，SN-WER能有效降低因罗马化引起的WER膨胀（最多12%），同时对语义错误的检测灵敏度与WER相近（Delta SN-WER / Delta WER ≈ 1.09）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WER在多语言场景下会因参考文本和假设文本使用不同文字系统（如天城文与罗马化转写）而高估错误率，导致模型间的性能差距被夸大。现有指标缺乏对文字系统差异的鲁棒性。

Method: SN-WER是一种无需训练、仅用于评估的打分方法。在计算WER前，将参考文本和假设文本统一转写为目标语言的标准文字，再计算编辑距离。该过程对转写器的选择具有鲁棒性。

Result: 在FLEURS数据集上，SN-WER将模型间被夸大的性能差距降低最多12%；在Common Voice上由于存在真正的识别错误，改进较小或不一致。人工罗马化的WER膨胀被衰减67%，SN-WER对语义错误的敏感性为Delta SN-WER / Delta WER ≈ 1.09。词汇碰撞率低于0.1%。

Conclusion: SN-WER应作为WER和CER的辅助指标，用于对文字系统不敏感的ASR评估，特别是在转录文本用于下游搜索、索引或多语言LLM流水线时。

Abstract: Word Error Rate (WER) is the dominant metric for automatic speech recognition (ASR), but it can overestimate errors when references and hypotheses encode the same words in different scripts. This issue is common in multilingual settings where ASR models may emit romanized text. We propose Script-Normalized WER (SN-WER), a training-free, evaluation-only scoring method that transliterates both reference and hypothesis text into a language-specific canonical script before computing WER. We evaluate SN-WER on 5 Indic languages, 2 datasets, and 3 ASR models. On curated FLEURS data, SN-WER reduces inflated model gaps by up to 12%, while on noisier Common Voice data the reductions are smaller or inconsistent, indicating genuine recognition weaknesses rather than only script mismatch. Controlled stress tests show a 67% attenuation of artificial romanization-induced WER inflation, while lexical-substitution controls show near-identical sensitivity to semantic errors, with Delta SN-WER / Delta WER approximately 1.09. SN-WER is robust to transliterator choice, normalization changes, and shows low token-collision rates below 0.1% in the evaluated Indic setting. We argue that SN-WER should be reported alongside WER and CER as a companion metric for script-insensitive ASR evaluation, especially when transcripts feed downstream search, indexing, or multilingual LLM pipelines.

</details>


### [188] [HERO'S JOURNEY: Testing Complex Rule Induction with Text Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02556)
*Anshun Asher Zheng,Kanishka Misra,David I. Beaver,Junyi Jessy Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出HERO'S JOURNEY基准，评估LLM在目标导向情节任务中的规则归纳能力，发现模型具备有限且不均衡的归纳能力，过程执行是瓶颈，程序性归纳仍是开放挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏对目标导向情节任务中规则归纳的系统评估，需要设计一个覆盖多种规则形式、可控词汇接地和可识别性条件的标准基准。

Method: 构建HERO'S JOURNEY基准，包含8个任务（属性和程序性归纳两类），每类4种结构规则形式，具备可控词汇接地和可识别性条件；评估多种SOTA LLM，并测试归纳特定引导方法。

Result: LLM展现出规则归纳证据但能力有限且不均匀；过程执行是执行瓶颈，表面语义影响极小；归纳引导方法能提升属性任务但无法可靠改进程序性任务。

Conclusion: 程序性归纳的差距仍是开放挑战，现有模型在此类任务上存在根本性局限。

Abstract: We introduce HERO'S JOURNEY, a benchmark for rule induction in goal-directed episodic tasks, where agents must infer hidden rules from demonstrations and act on them through multi-step execution. HERO'S JOURNEY covers eight tasks across attribute and procedural induction families, each with four structural rule forms, controllable lexical grounding, and identifiability conditions. Evaluating state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that models show evidence of rule induction, but the ability is limited and uneven across tasks. Meanwhile, process execution adds an execution bottleneck for models, whereas surface semantics has minimal effect. Induction-specific steering methods improve performance on attribute tasks but show no reliable gains on procedural tasks, suggesting the gap in procedural induction remains an open challenge.

</details>


### [189] [From Layers to Submodules: Rethinking Granularity in Replacement-Based LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02559)
*Elia Cunegatti,Marcus Vukojevic,Erik Nielsen,Giovanni Iacca*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SubFit是一种面向大语言模型的子模块级后训练压缩方法，通过非连续选择注意力与前馈子模块并为其配备轻量级残差旁路，在多种稀疏度下实现了优于现有方法的困惑度-准确率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于替换的LLM压缩方法受限于全层粒度和连续选择，无法有效处理预训练Transformer中冗余并非连续分布、不同子模块类型需要不同近似策略的问题。

Method: SubFit在子模块级别（Attention和FeedForward）非连续地选择可移除组件，并为每个被选子模块配备一个轻量级拟合残差旁路（fitted residual bypass），仅需校准数据即可完成后训练压缩。

Result: 在10个LLM（5个基座+5个指令微调）上、5种稀疏度（12.5%-37.5%）下、与4种基线方法对比，SubFit在聚合困惑度-准确率权衡上达到最优。25%稀疏度时保持84.6%的下游准确率，困惑度上升2.42倍，优于基线方法的81.6%和4.34倍。

Conclusion: SubFit通过子模块级非连续选择与定制化残差旁路，更灵活地适配了Transformer中的冗余分布，在保持高效推理加速和KV缓存节省的同时实现了更优的压缩性能。

Abstract: Post-training compression of Large Language Models (LLMs) removes entire architectural components, either deleting them or replacing them with fitted modules. Existing replacement-based methods share two design constraints: full-layer granularity and contiguous selection. We argue that this is overly restrictive: in fact, redundancy in pretrained transformers is not confined to contiguous regions, nor does it evenly distribute between Attention and FeedForward outputs, implying that different strategies best approximate different submodule types and that removable components need not cluster within contiguous depth ranges. Based on this intuition, we introduce SubFit (Submodule-level Fitted residual replacement), which compresses LLMs at the submodule level: Attention and FeedForward submodules are selected non-contiguously, and each receives its own lightweight fitted residual bypass. SubFit operates post-training and requires only calibration data. Across ten LLMs (five base, five instruction-tuned), five sparsity levels from 12.5% to 37.5%, and four replacement-based baselines, SubFit achieves the best aggregate perplexity-accuracy trade-off across the evaluated sparsity levels, with larger gains under aggressive compression. At 25% sparsity, it retains 84.6% of dense downstream accuracy and incurs 2.42x perplexity degradation, against 81.6% and 4.34x for the strongest baselines, while delivering measurable inference speedup and KV-cache savings. Code is available at https://github.com/eliacunegatti/SubFit.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [190] [BitsMoE: Efficient Spectral Energy-Guided Bit Allocation for MoE LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00079)
*Jiayu Zhao,Zihan Teng,Minhao Fan,Tianrui Ma,Wentao Ren,Song Chen,Weichen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BitsMoE提出了一种基于谱能量引导的比特分配框架，通过SVD分解将MoE层分解为共享基和专家特定谱因子，并利用整数线性规划实现混合精度量化，在超低位宽下显著提升了MoE大模型的量化效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE压缩方法在超低位宽场景下存在不足：剪枝不可逆地移除模型容量，粗粒度量化无法根据专家和权重方向的重要性分配比特，导致MoE模型部署仍存在严重的内存瓶颈。

Method: 通过SVD将每个MoE层分解为共享基（不量化以保留跨专家公共结构）和专家特定谱因子（作为细粒度量化单元）；设计激活感知的重建代理损失，通过整数线性规划在固定比特预算下最小化估计重建误差，实现谱级混合精度量化。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base上，2-bit量化相较GPTQ加速量化12.3倍，平均准确率提升27.83个百分点，解码速度提升1.76倍。

Conclusion: BitsMoE在超低位宽下显著降低了MoE大模型下游任务的精度退化，是一种高效的MoE量化框架。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, but their deployment remains memory-intensive because all expert weights must be kept resident in memory. Existing MoE compression methods struggle in the ultra-low-bit regime: pruning irreversibly removes model capacity, while coarse-grained quantization fails to allocate bits according to heterogeneous expert and weight-direction importance. We propose BitsMoE, a spectral-energy-guided bit-allocation framework for MoE LLM quantization. BitsMoE decomposes each MoE layer by SVD into a shared basis and expert-specific spectral factors, retaining the shared basis without quantization to preserve common cross-expert structure and using the expert-specific factors as fine-grained quantization units. To determine the bit-width of each unit, BitsMoE formulates spectrum-wise mixed-precision quantization as an activation-aware reconstruction surrogate and solves an integer linear program that minimizes estimated reconstruction loss under a fixed bit budget. Experiments across multiple MoE LLMs show that BitsMoE substantially reduces downstream task accuracy degradation in ultra-low-bit regimes. Under 2-bit quantization on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, BitsMoE accelerates quantization by 12.3$\times$, improves average accuracy by 27.83 percentage points, and increases decoding speed by 1.76$\times$ over GPTQ. Our model and code are publicly available at https://github.com/zjiayu064/BitsMoE.

</details>


### [191] [DAStatFormer: A Hybrid Multibranch Transformer with Statistical Feature Integration for DAS-Based Pattern Recognitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00081)
*Michel Dione,Jerry Lonlac,Hélène Louis,Anthony Fleury,Stephane Lecoeuche*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DAStatFormer，一种混合多分支Transformer，通过提取时域、波形和频域的24个ANOVA统计特征替代原始DAS信号，结合门控Transformer网络，在Φ-OTDR基准和真实DAS数据集上达到99.4%准确率，显著降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DAS数据维度高、时空模式复杂，现有深度学习方法（CNN、RNN、Transformer变体）要么无法捕捉长程依赖，要么处理原始DAS矩阵计算成本过高，难以满足大规模实时监测需求。

Method: 采用混合多分支Transformer架构：1) 从时域、波形和频域每通道提取24个ANOVA筛选的统计特征，大幅降低数据维度；2) 每个域通过专用的逐步注意力和通道注意力分支处理；3) 采用自适应门控机制融合多域特征。

Result: 在开放Φ-OTDR基准和真实DAS数据集上，DAStatFormer达到99.4%准确率，真实场景近乎完美表现，参数量和推理成本显著低于DASFormer和DeepViT等模型。

Conclusion: DAStatFormer以极低的计算开销实现了高精度事件分类，适合可扩展的实时DAS监测应用。

Abstract: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) enables large-scale monitoring through optical fibers, but its high dimensionality and complex spatio-temporal patterns make event classification demanding. Existing deep learning approaches-CNNs, recurrent models, and Transformer variants-either fail to capture long-range dependencies or require processing raw DAS matrices at prohibitive cost. We propose DAStatFormer, a hybrid multibranch Transformer that combines compact multidomain statistical features with Gated Transformer Networks. Instead of raw signals, we extract 24 ANOVA-selected attributes per channel from the temporal, waveform, and spectral domains, reducing data size by orders of magnitude while preserving discriminative information. Each domain is processed via dedicated step-wise and channel-wise attention branches, fused by an adaptive gating mechanism. Experiments on the open $Φ$-OTDR benchmark and a real-scenario DAS dataset show that DAS-tatFormer achieves up to 99.4% accuracy and near-perfect real-world performance, while using significantly fewer parameters and lower inference cost than models such as DASFormer and DeepViT. These results demonstrate its suitability for scalable, real-time DAS-based monitoring. We release our code at https://github.com/MichelD-git/DAStatFormer

</details>


### [192] [Hoeffding Concept Bottleneck Models with Applications to Overhead Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00082)
*Clément Bénard,Manon Arfib,Christophe Labreuche,Victor Quétu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Hoeffding概念瓶颈模型（HCBM），利用梯度提升树的Hoeffding函数分解实现非线性稀疏聚合，替代传统线性聚合方法，在提高可解释性的同时保持高准确率，并能拓展至目标检测任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CBM方法采用线性聚合概念分数来预测，但大量概念的线性聚合削弱可解释性并导致信息泄漏，且概念与输出logit之间并非线性关系，需要更合理的非线性稀疏聚合方法。

Method: 基于梯度提升树的Hoeffding函数分解，构建非线性稀疏的概念分数聚合，并使用素蕴含项生成紧凑预测。

Result: HCBM对概念间信息泄漏具有鲁棒性，在广泛实验中优于标准线性CBM，在航拍目标检测等挑战性场景中表现优异。

Conclusion: 非线性稀疏聚合是提升CBM可解释性与性能的有效方向，HCBM可拓展至分类以外的目标检测任务，具有广泛应用潜力。

Abstract: Explainability of deep learning algorithms is critical for computer-vision applications with high-stake decisions. Concept bottleneck models (CBM) have recently shown promising performance to provide explainable and accurate predictions for classification problems, based on a bottleneck of high-level concepts. Existing CBM methods rely on a linear aggregation of the concept scores to compute predictions. However, a large number of concepts is often used in this linear approach, which undermines explainability and favors information leakage. In general, the underlying relation between concepts and output logits is not linear. Therefore, we introduce Hoeffding Concept Bottleneck Models (HCBM), which build on the Hoeffding functional decomposition of gradient-boosted trees to provide non-linear and sparse aggregations of concept scores, and generate compact predictions using prime implicants. HCBM are proved to be robust to interconcept leakage, and outperform standard linear CBM in practice, as shown in extensive experiments. Beyond classification, HCBM can be adapted to object detection, and we focus on a challenging case with overhead images to show the high performance of HCBM in these settings.

</details>


### [193] [From Demonstrations to Rewards: Test-Time Prompt Optimization for VLM Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00083)
*Christian Gumbsch,Leonardo Barcellona,Lennard Schünemann,Platon Karageorgis,Andrii Zadaianchuk,Zehao Wang,Sergey Zakharov,Fabien Despinoy,Rahaf Aljundi,Efstratios Gavves*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Demo2Reward是一种测试时自适应技术，通过少量专家演示（3-10条轨迹）优化VLM奖励模型的语言指令，在无需额外训练的情况下减少假阳性奖励，显著提升了机器人策略学习的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于VLM的零样本奖励模型在没有精细提示工程的情况下会产生次优奖励，其中假阳性预测会严重降低下游策略学习质量。而机器人领域通常拥有少量专家演示数据，这为在策略训练前优化奖励模型提供了机会。

Method: 提出Demo2Reward，一种测试时自适应技术，利用少量专家演示（3-10条轨迹）优化VLM奖励模型的语言指令，在不进行额外模型训练或增加计算资源的前提下，减少假阳性同时保持真阳性。

Result: 在多种模拟机器人任务和策略骨干网络上，Demo2Reward持续优于现有的零样本和少样本VLM奖励模型，并且成功迁移到真实机器人学习场景。

Conclusion: Demo2Reward通过少量演示即可有效优化VLM奖励模型，无需手动设计奖励函数，为真实机器人策略学习提供了一种实用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning relies on accurate reward functions, which are often hand-crafted or even unavailable in real-world applications, such as robotics. Recent work has explored the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models. However, without careful prompt engineering, these approaches tend to produce suboptimal rewards, where false positive predictions can severely degrade downstream policy learning. In robotics, limited datasets comprising expert demonstrations are often collected to bootstrap policy learning. This scenario provides an opportunity to optimize a reward model prior policy training. We propose Demo2Reward a test-time adaptation technique to optimize the language instruction of a reward model based on a few demonstrations (3-10 trajectories) to reduce false positives while preserving true positives. Crucially, this requires no additional model training or computation resources during policy learning. We show that Demo2Reward consistently outperforms existing zero- and few-shot VLM reward models across a range of simulated robotic tasks and policy backbones. Finally, we demonstrate that Demo2Reward effectively transfers to a real-world robotic learning scenario, enabling policy learning without manually engineering a reward function.

</details>


### [194] [A Shared Valence Axis Across Modern LLMs and Human EEG: The Saturation Regularity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00129)
*Yousef A. Radwan,Xuhui Liu,Kilichbek Haydarov,Yuqian Fu,Mohamed Elhoseiny*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM能否作为理解人脑EEG中情感效价神经表征的透镜。通过仅用9个句子构建LLM中的情感效价方向（V-axis），验证其跨模型一致性，并发现该方向可映射到人脑EEG活动。但进一步发现，25种对齐策略均无法提升解码性能，由此提出“饱和规律”：任务标签已驱动模型到达目标方向时，额外监督会扭曲饱和盆地。基于该发现，通过集成残差多样性提升平衡准确率10.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究现代LLM的内部表征能否作为理解人脑中情感效价神经表征的有效工具，并验证语言模型与大脑电生理活动在情感效价结构上是否具有一致性。

Method: 1) 从LLM中仅用9个情感句子构建一维效价方向（V-axis），通过零样本迁移和跨14个模型一致性验证；2) 在123名被试的EEG数据集上，通过线性投影验证LLM效价方向与EEG特征的对齐；3) 测试25种对齐策略（知识蒸馏、表征相似性、对比学习、拓扑损失等）；4) 提出饱和规律并基于残差多样性集成改进解码。

Result: 1) LLM构建的V-axis在零样本情感分类和跨模型一致性上有效；2) EEG线性投影能追踪V-axis位置，36个情感分类器自发发现相同方向；3) 25种对齐策略均不提升解码性能，16种显著降低精度；4) 基于残差多样性集成策略在FACED上提升平衡准确率10.5%，在SEED-V上验证了相同效果。

Conclusion: LLM的效价表征与人脑EEG信号存在结构对齐，但直接对齐训练面临饱和规律的限制——任务标签已主导解码方向时，额外监督无效甚至有害。改进方向在于利用监督无法触及的残差子空间，通过集成残差多样性来提升解码性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful representation learners whose internal features increasingly align with human cognition. We study whether modern LLMs can serve as a lens for understanding neural representations in the human brain, focusing on emotional valence in EEG.
  We first build a one-dimensional valence direction, the V-axis, from modern LLMs using only nine emotion-evocative sentences. We validate it through zero-shot transfer to sentiment benchmarks and cross-model consistency across fourteen LLMs. We then show that this LLM-derived direction maps onto human neural activity. On a public EEG cohort of 123 subjects watching affective videos, a single linear projection on EEG features tracks the V-axis position of each stimulus. Moreover, 36 EEG emotion classifiers trained without exposure to the V-axis spontaneously rediscover the same direction in their internal representations, suggesting that the same valence structure emerges in both language models and human electrophysiology.
  Yet this convergence does not provide an effective training signal. We test twenty-five alignment strategies, including knowledge distillation, representational similarity, contrastive, and topographic losses; none improve decoding, and sixteen significantly reduce accuracy. We formalize this result as the saturation regularity: once task labels alone drive a brain-decoding network onto the target direction, additional supervision mainly distorts an already-saturated basin, while the load-bearing within-class residual receives little useful gradient.
  This regularity also indicates where improvement should come from: the residual subspace unreachable by supervision. Motivated by this insight, we ensemble across residual diversity rather than supervising the basin, improving balanced accuracy by 10.5% over the prior best on FACED, with the same effect replicated on SEED-V.

</details>


### [195] [Automatically Differentiable Nonlinear Tensor Networks (ADNTNs) for Exponential Compression of Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00130)
*Andrzej Cichocki,Michal Wietczak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可自动微分非线性张量网络（ADNTNs），一种通过反向模式自动微分端到端训练紧凑核心张量的结构化权重生成器。研究聚焦于三种架构：树张量网络（TTN）、增强TTN（aTTN）和多尺度纠缠重整化拟设（MERA）。在AlexNet和VGG-16上的实验表明，每层压缩比可达2000倍至77000倍，且精度常能匹配甚至超越密集基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将张量网络从静态压缩工具扩展为可端到端训练的权重生成结构，在保持数学结构的同时实现大规模神经网络压缩，并支持非线性激活、任务感知目标和硬件感知执行。

Method: 提出ADNTN框架，通过小型核心张量的层次化组合构建大型权重张量，支持非线性激活、横向混合张量，并通过反向模式自动微分端到端训练。研究了TTN、aTTN（含边界解缠器）和MERA三种架构，强调自动微分不消除大中间变量或复杂收缩顺序的成本。

Result: 在AlexNet和VGG-16各层上实现每层约2000倍至77000倍的压缩比，精度常匹配甚至超越密集基线模型（尤其在VGG-16上）。

Conclusion: ADNTNs是一种有前景、具有数学结构且硬件感知的神经网络压缩途径，但需要将优化、收缩调度和部署内核共同设计才能充分发挥潜力。

Abstract: We study Automatically Differentiable Nonlinear Tensor Networks (ADNTNs), a family of structured weight generators whose compact core tensors are trained end-to-end by reverse-mode automatic differentiation (AD). The approach can be viewed as a natural extension of low-rank adaptation and tensor factorisation: instead of using one low-rank matrix update, an ADNTN builds a large weight tensor through a hierarchy of small cores, nonlinear activations, and optional lateral mixing tensors. The paper focuses on three architectures: Tree Tensor Networks (TTNs), augmented TTNs (aTTNs) with boundary disentanglers, and Multi-scale Entanglement Renormalisation Ansatze (MERA).
  The formulation supports nonlinear activations, task-aware objectives, batching, and hardware-aware execution schedules. At the same time, the paper keeps a clear distinction between \emph{differentiating} a contraction program and making contraction free: AD does not remove the cost of large intermediates, poor contraction orders, or exact contraction of general loopy tensor networks.
  Extensive simulations on AlexNet and VGG-16 layers show per-layer compression ratios from roughly $2000\times$ to $77000\times$ in the studied settings, with accuracy often matching the dense baseline and, in several VGG-16 cases, improving it. These results are encouraging rather than final: they suggest that ADNTNs are a promising, mathematically structured, and hardware-aware route toward much smaller neural networks, provided that optimisation, contraction schedules, and deployment kernels are designed together.

</details>


### [196] [Foundation-Preserving Adaptation via Generalized Rayleigh-Quotient Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00132)
*Dongjun Kim,Adrian de Wynter,Huancheng Chen,Heasung Kim,Haris Vikalo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FoLoRA框架，通过广义瑞利商对更新方向进行效用/遗忘评分，并在训练中动态衰减低效方向，实现自适应微调与知识保留的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调会损害基础模型在预训练中获得的其他能力，现有方法通过特殊初始化或固定约束寻求更安全的更新，但未在训练过程中动态调节适应性与保留性之间的权衡。

Method: 1) 基于一阶保留条件定义遗忘惩罚（预训练代理激活）和任务效用（下游任务激活）；2) 通过广义瑞利商计算每个更新方向的任务效用/遗忘惩罚得分；3) 构建谱坐标系，实现方向级门控Adam更新，衰减低效用-惩罚比的方向；4) 从预训练模型采样构建校准数据，无需单一代理数据集。

Result: 在数学、代码和指令跟随任务上，FoLoRA相比基线方法实现了最强的最优保留-适应平衡，在提升目标任务性能的同时，最大程度地保持了非目标能力。

Conclusion: 方向级遗忘感知优化是有效平衡微调适应性与预训练知识保留的关键，无需依赖固定约束或单一代理数据集即可实现。

Abstract: While finetuning effectively adapts foundation models to specialized downstream tasks, it can degrade nontarget capabilities acquired during pretraining. Existing forgetting aware methods typically seek safer updates through specialized initialization or fixed constraints, but do not regulate the adaptation preservation trade-off during training. We propose Foundation Preserving LoRA (FoLoRA), a forgetting aware optimization framework. Guided by a first order preservation condition, FoLoRA defines a forgetting penalty over pretraining-proxy activations and a task utility over downstream task activations. It then scores update directions by task utility per unit forgetting penalty via a generalized Rayleigh quotient. The resulting spectral coordinate system enables direction wise gated Adam updates, attenuating low utility to penalty directions during training. To estimate the forgetting penalty, FoLoRA constructs pretraining proxy calibration data by sampling from the pretrained model rather than relying on a single proxy dataset. Experiments on math, code, and instruction following adaptation show that FoLoRA achieves the strongest preservation adaptation balance over baselines, improving target task performance with best aggregate preservation of non target capabilities.

</details>


### [197] [World Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Methodologies, Reasoning Paradigms, and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00133)
*Arif Hassan Zidan,Yi Pan,Hanqi Jiang,Ruiyu Yan,Wei Ruan,Zihao Wu,Lifeng Chen,Weihang You,Xinliang Li,Bowen Chen,Huawen Hu,Peilong Wang,Sizhuang Liu,Jing Zhang,Siyuan Li,Zhengliang Liu,Yu Bao,Lin Zhao,Lichao Sun,Dajiang Zhu,Xiang Li,Jinglei Lv,Quanzheng Li,Wei Liu,Tianming Liu,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对世界模型领域进行了系统性综述，提出了一个四维分类法（架构、方法论、推理策略、应用领域），从早期认知科学基础追踪到PlaNet、Dreamer、MuZero、Sora等里程碑系统，并指出了该领域面临的预测误差累积、仿真到现实迁移、评估碎片化等核心挑战及未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型在通向AGI的过程中已成为核心范式，但该领域缺乏一个统一的框架来整合多样化的架构选择、训练方法、推理机制和应用场景，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 提出多轴分类法，沿四个维度组织：（i）架构（表示形式、动态公式、输入模态、学习范式、下游应用）；（ii）方法论家族（状态空间/循环方法、Transformer、扩散生成器、物理信息网络、语言增强多模态系统）；（iii）推理策略（想象规划、潜在策略学习、反事实推理、不确定性规划）；（iv）应用领域（机器人、自动驾驶、视频预测、多模态智能体、强化学习、科学建模、医学成像、教育测量、商业金融）。

Result: 梳理了从早期认知科学到PlaNet、Dreamer家族、MuZero、Sora、Cosmos、Genie等里程碑系统的发展脉络；揭示了链式思维推理与世界模型想象的近期融合趋势；回顾了评估协议与基准；识别了预测误差累积、仿真到现实迁移、评估碎片化等持续挑战。

Conclusion: 未来方向包括：统一多模态世界模型、基础规模交互式模拟器，以及在安全关键领域的安全部署。

Abstract: World models, internal simulators that learn the structure and dynamics of an environment, have emerged as a central paradigm in the pursuit of artificial general intelligence, enabling agents to predict, plan, and reason within learned representations. Despite rapid progress across reinforcement learning, robotics, autonomous driving, and video generation, the field lacks a unified framework integrating its diverse architectural choices, training methods, reasoning mechanisms, and application settings. This survey addresses that gap with a multi-axis taxonomy organized along four dimensions: (i) architecture, encompassing representation format, dynamics formulation, input modality, learning paradigm, and downstream application; (ii) methodological family, including state-space and recurrent approaches, transformer-based models, diffusion-based generators, physics-informed networks, and language-augmented multimodal systems; (iii) reasoning strategy, covering imagination-based planning, latent policy learning, counterfactual reasoning, and planning under uncertainty; and (iv) application domain, spanning robotics, autonomous driving, video prediction, multimodal agents, reinforcement learning, scientific modeling, medical imaging, educational measurement, and business and finance. Tracing the field from early cognitive-science foundations to milestone systems such as PlaNet, the Dreamer family, MuZero, Sora, Cosmos, and Genie, we examine how these dimensions interact and highlight the recent convergence of chain-of-thought reasoning with world-model imagination. We review evaluation protocols and benchmarks, identify persistent challenges such as compounding prediction errors, sim-to-real transfer, and fragmented evaluation, and outline future directions toward unified multimodal world models, foundation-scale interactive simulators, and safe deployment in safety-critical domains.

</details>


### [198] [On Effectiveness and Efficiency of Agentic Tool-calling and RL Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00135)
*Tong Liu,Cheng Qian,Matej Cief,Yuan He,Daniele Dan,Nikolaos Aletras,Gabriella Kazai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM智能体中工具调用的有效性和效率两个维度。有效性方面，发现评估管线对实现细节高度敏感（如随机种子、系统提示、多轮模板等），导致排行榜排名不可靠。效率方面，识别了RL训练中的两类计算浪费，并提出两种加速技术，在不降低性能的前提下显著提升训练速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用是现代LLM智能体的核心能力，但其评估和训练方法缺乏系统研究。现有评估管线存在许多未被标准化的实现细节，可能导致结果不可靠；同时RL训练工具调用的计算效率低下，需要优化。

Method: 在有效性维度，系统分析工具调用评估管线的各个组件（随机种子、系统提示、多轮模板、历史交互传递方式）对结果的影响。在效率维度，识别RL训练中两类计算浪费（无效rollout和高计算成本的策略更新），并提出两种加速技术。

Result: 评估管线对看似微小的实现选择高度敏感，尤其是在多轮设置中，缺乏标准化导致排行榜排名不可靠。RL训练中存在两类计算浪费，提出的加速技术在不降低性能的情况下实现了显著的时钟时间加速。

Conclusion: 工具调用的评估需要标准化以确保结果可靠性；RL训练可通过消除计算浪费来大幅提升效率。

Abstract: Tool-calling is a central component of modern large language model (LLM) agents, equipping them with skills beyond their parametric knowledge. This paper studies tool-calling along two complementary axes: effectiveness, i.e., how this capability is measured, and efficiency, i.e., how it is learned. On effectiveness, we systematically analyze tool-calling evaluation pipelines and show that results can be highly sensitive to seemingly minor, often undocumented implementation choices including the random seed, system prompt, multi-turn template construction, and how prior interaction/reasoning history is carried forward. These choices can lead to substantial differences in reported performance, especially in multi-turn settings where without rigorous standardization, leaderboard rankings are unreliable. On efficiency, we examine standard reinforcement learning (RL) for tool-calling and identify two sources of computational waste: (i) during rollouts, many prompts produce no learning signal, and (ii) during policy updates, optimization incurs high computational cost. Guided by these findings, we introduce two techniques that accelerate RL-based tool-calling training, achieving substantial wall-clock speedup without degrading performance.

</details>


### [199] [Generative AI and Digital Ecosystem Resilience: A Proactive Lifecycle-Based Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00136)
*Jonghyun Chung,Rishabh Chaddha,Sanket Badhe,Debanshu Das,Nathan Huang,Amanpreet Kaur*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文综述了从传统被动检测向主动检测新兴合成叙事（由生成式AI加速的对抗性内容）的范式转变，基于C5交互模型（上下文、原因、内容、放大循环、后果）的生命周期分类法，系统梳理了机器学习与社会科学交叉领域的前沿方法，包括协调不真实行为分析、流行病学建模、Hawkes过程、高维异常检测、多层图无监督协调检测及智能体AI系统，并探讨了生成式AI带来的快速变化威胁和多层分布漂移等挑战，提出了未来研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI（GenAI）加速了对抗性合成内容的扩散，传统被动检测方法已失效，亟需转向主动检测新兴不真实叙事的范式。

Method: 采用统一的基于生命周期的分类法，以C5交互模型（Context, Causes, Content, Cycle of Amplification, Consequences）为分析框架，融合机器学习和社会科学的研究流，系统综述了合成放大模式与真实基线的区分技术（包括协调不真实行为分析、流行病学建模、Hawkes过程）以及各阶段主动检测方法（高维嵌入空间异常检测、多层图无监督协调检测、智能体AI系统）。

Result: 系统综述了面向新兴合成威胁的主动检测方法体系，识别了GenAI带来的关键挑战（快速变化威胁追踪、多层分布漂移），并提出了聚焦异常聚类检测与构建预期性韧性系统的未来研究方向。

Conclusion: 综述表明，基于生命周期的综合分析框架能够为构建更具韧性的信息生态系统提供系统性的主动检测方法论基础。

Abstract: The proliferation of adversarial synthetic content, accelerated by Generative AI (GenAI) is rendering traditional reactive detection methods ineffective. This survey synthesizes emerging research to demonstrate a paradigm shift toward the proactive detection of emerging inauthentic narratives. In this survey, we adopt a unified, lifecycle-based taxonomy to combine socio-technical lifecycle models of adversarial campaigns with advanced computational methodologies for emerging inauthentic narrative detection. By structuring the analysis around the C5 Interaction Model (Context, Causes, Content, Cycle of Amplification, Consequences), we integrate different research streams from machine learning and social science. To differentiate spread patterns of synthetic amplification from authentic baseline traffic, this paper surveys state-of-the-art techniques for modeling the creation, seeding, and propagation of fresh narratives, including the analysis of Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior (CIB), epidemiological modeling, and Hawkes process. This survey also provides a systematic review of proactive detection methods for adversarial threats at different stages in the C5 interaction model, specifically, anomaly detection in high-dimensional embedding spaces, unsupervised coordination detection on multi-layer graphs, and agentic AI systems. Finally, this survey addresses challenges posed by GenAI, including the difficulty of tracking rapidly changing threats and multi-level distributional drift, and it outlines a future research agenda focused on detecting anomalous clusters and building anticipatory and resilient systems. This survey provides a comprehensive, lifecycle-based review of methods for the proactive detection of emerging synthetic threats for more resilient information ecosystems.

</details>


### [200] [Geometric Erasure by Contrastive Velocity Matching in Rectified Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00140)
*Jonas Henry Grebe,Tobias Braun,Anna Rohrbach,Marcus Rohrbach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GEM框架，用于Rectified Flow模型中的概念擦除，通过结合生成流网络的轨迹遗忘和教师引导擦除，实现针对性的有害概念抑制同时保持良性生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态生成模型的快速发展带来了有害内容合成、深度伪造和版权侵犯等风险，而概念擦除技术尚未跟上从U-Net扩散模型到Rectified Flow Transformer的转型。

Method: 提出GEM框架，将基于轨迹的遗忘信号（来自生成流网络）转化为教师引导的流匹配设置，教师提供互补的吸引和排斥信号，统一为单一的几何引导目标。

Result: 实现针对性的有害概念抑制，同时保持良性生成能力。

Conclusion: GEM简单但高效，统一了轨迹遗忘和教师引导擦除两种范式的优势，为Rectified Flow模型提供了有效的概念擦除方案。

Abstract: While the rapid adoption of multimodal generative models offers immense potential, it has also increased the risks of harmful content synthesis, deepfakes, and copyright infringements. To address these challenges, concept erasure has emerged as a prospective safeguard. However, as the field gradually transitions from U-Net-based diffusion models to Rectified Flow Transformers, erasure research has struggled to keep pace. In this work, we introduce GEM, a simple but highly effective erasure framework for Rectified Flow models. As part of our contribution, we establish a principled bridge between trajectory-based unlearning grounded in Generative Flow Networks and classic teacher-guided erasure: we translate trajectory-based signals into a teacher-guided flow-matching setup that unifies the strengths of both paradigms. Concretely, a teacher provides complementary attraction and repulsion signals that we combine into a single geometric guidance objective, yielding targeted suppression of unwanted concepts while preserving benign generation.

</details>


### [201] [Adaptive data selection improves wearable prediction under low baseline performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00141)
*Ali Kargarandehkordi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究评估了自适应传感策略在可穿戴健康系统中选择性采样时间窗口的效果，发现该策略对基线性能较低的参与者能显著提升AUROC（最高达0.7），而对基线性能较好的参与者提升有限甚至为负。自适应增益与基线性能呈强负相关（Pearson r=-0.67; Spearman ρ=-0.62），且AUROC提升在60-80%的参与者中可见，但F1改善较小且不稳定。结论建议根据基线性能选择性部署自适应传感策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可穿戴健康系统在有限数据预算下使用自适应传感策略以提升预测性能，但这些策略在不同个体间的收益差异尚不明确，作者旨在系统评估这种差异性。

Method: 在纵向可穿戴数据集中，针对心率、活动和生态瞬时评估（EMA）多种传感模态，在固定测量预算下评估自适应选择训练时间窗口的效果，以AUROC和F1分数为指标，与随机采样对比量化性能提升。

Result: 自适应策略对基线性能低的参与者AUROC提升显著（最高0.7），对基线强者提升有限或负向；自适应增益与基线性能强负相关（Pearson r=-0.67; Spearman ρ=-0.62）；60-80%参与者在AUROC上获益，但F1改善较小且不一致。

Conclusion: 自适应传感并非普遍有益，其最大价值体现在低性能场景；建议基于基线性能选择性部署自适应传感策略以提高可穿戴健康监测的效率。

Abstract: Adaptive sensing strategies that selectively sample data are increasingly used in wearable health systems to improve prediction performance under limited data budgets, yet their benefits across individuals remain poorly understood. Here, we evaluate adaptive selection of time windows for model training under fixed measurement budgets across multiple sensing modalities, including heart rate, activity, and ecological momentary assessment (EMA), in a longitudinal wearable dataset. We quantify performance gains relative to random sampling using both area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and F1 score. Adaptive strategies yield substantial improvements in AUROC for participants with low baseline performance (with gains up to 0.7), while offering limited or negative gains for participants with strong baselines. Across modalities, adaptive gain is strongly inversely correlated with baseline performance (Pearson r = -0.67; Spearman p = -0.62). At the participant level, most individuals benefit in AUROC (60-80% across modalities), although improvements in F1 are smaller and less consistent. These findings show that adaptive sensing is not uniformly beneficial, but instead provides the greatest value in underperforming settings. Our results support selective deployment strategies that tailor adaptive sensing based on baseline performance to improve efficiency in wearable health monitoring.

</details>


### [202] [BudgetDraft: Acceptance-Aware Multi-View Training for Sparse-KV Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00144)
*Liang He,Jingbo Wen,Qishi Zhan,Yixiong Chen,Kangning Cui,Qizhen Lan,Xilu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BudgetDraft提出了一种多视角稀疏训练方法，通过让草稿模型在训练时暴露于多种KV缓存预算下，学习与共享的全缓存教师目标对齐，从而解决中长上下文推理中稀疏/全缓存不匹配导致的接受率下降问题，在4K-16K上下文长度下实现了最高6.55倍端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在资源受限的部署场景中，推测解码使用稀疏KV缓存的草稿模型和全缓存验证器存在稀疏/全缓存不匹配问题，随着上下文长度增长（4K-16K），接受率迅速下降，影响解码效率。

Method: 提出BudgetDraft多视角稀疏训练方法：1）训练时让草稿模型暴露于多种采样的KV预算下；2）将每个稀疏视角与共享的全缓存教师目标对齐；3）结合全缓存分支的接受感知损失和稀疏缓存分支的多视角损失，训练出单一对预算鲁棒的草稿模型。

Result: 在PG-19、LongBench和LWM数据集上，BudgetDraft在4K、8K、16K上下文长度下分别实现高达6.55倍、4.46倍和2.10倍的端到端加速，同时保持推理管道的低内存占用。

Conclusion: BudgetDraft通过多视角训练有效解决了稀疏/全缓存不匹配问题，在不增加推理时组件开销的情况下，实现了中长上下文场景下的高效推测解码，兼顾了加速性能和内存友好性。

Abstract: Speculative decoding speeds up autoregressive decoding by using a drafter to propose multiple tokens that a verifier validates in parallel. In resource-constrained deployments, the drafter uses a sparse KV cache to limit peak GPU memory and end-to-end latency under a fixed KV budget, while the verifier keeps a full KV cache. Mid-to-long context inference (4K--16K context length) is common in real applications. However, naive sparse/full speculative decoding suffers from the sparse/full mismatch as context length grows, causing the acceptance rate to drop quickly. We propose BudgetDraft, a multi-view sparse training method for sparse drafting in mid-to-long inference. The drafter is exposed to multiple sampled KV budgets during training and learns to align each sparse view with one shared full-cache teacher target. BudgetDraft combines an acceptance-aware loss on a full-cache branch with a multi-view loss on a sparse-cache branch, producing a single budget-robust drafter that recovers acceptance across sparsity levels without extra inference-time components. Experimental results on PG-19, LongBench, and LWM show that BudgetDraft achieves up to 6.55x, 4.46x, and 2.10x end-to-end speedup vs AR at 4K, 8K, and 16K context lengths, while keeping the inference pipeline memory-friendly.

</details>


### [203] [RAFT: Data Refinement and Adaptive Distillation for Domain Fine-Tuning with Alleviated Forgetting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00147)
*Yuduo Li,Xiaofeng Shi,Qian Kou,Longbin Yu,Hua Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAFT是一个两阶段框架，通过数据精炼（自条件重写、语义过滤、答案融合）和自适应蒸馏（答案条件在线策略蒸馏、Top-K温度蒸馏、EMA自适应损失平衡）来解决领域微调中的遗忘问题，在提升领域性能的同时恢复通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 领域SFT存在两个实际问题导致通用能力退化：监督兼容性缺口（领域目标与模型自然响应的风格和推理格式不匹配）和轨迹保留缺口（教师强迫SFT优化固定目标token，未约束模型自身生成前缀上的行为）。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) 数据精炼：自条件重写、语义过滤、答案融合，构建与模型兼容的监督信号；(2) 答案条件在线策略蒸馏：原始指令微调模型在学生生成轨迹上提供软目标，并以融合答案作为有用上下文，结合Top-K温度蒸馏和EMA自适应损失平衡。

Result: 在三个指令微调骨干和五个领域上，RAFT比标准SFT平均领域准确率提升23.2%，在MS-Bench和IFEval上分别相对提升18.2%和10.2%的通用能力。

Conclusion: 将数据精炼与轨迹级保留相结合为缓解遗忘的领域微调提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Domain-specific supervised fine-tuning (SFT) often improves in-domain performance at the cost of degrading a model's general capabilities. We view this degradation through two practical gaps in domain SFT: a supervision-compatibility gap, where domain targets differ in style and reasoning format from the original model's natural responses, and a trajectory-preservation gap, where teacher-forced SFT optimizes fixed target tokens without constraining the model's behavior on its own generated prefixes. This process fails to preserve the model's original behavior. We propose RAFT (Data Refinement and Adaptive Distillation for Domain Fine-Tuning with Alleviated Forgetting), a two-stage framework that addresses both factors. First, RAFT constructs model-compatible supervision through self-conditioned rewriting, semantic filtering, and answer fusion. Second, RAFT performs Answer-Conditioned On-Policy Distillation, where the original instruction-tuned model provides soft targets on student-generated trajectories while being conditioned on the fused answer as helpful context. We further introduce top-K temperature distillation and EMA-based adaptive loss balancing to stabilize the domain-general trade-off. Across three instruction-tuned backbones and five domains, RAFT improves average domain accuracy by 23.2% over standard SFT, while recovering part of the SFT-induced degradation on MS-Bench and IFEval, with relative improvements of 18.2% and 10.2%, respectively. These results show that coupling data refinement with trajectory-level preservation provides an effective recipe for domain fine-tuning with alleviated forgetting.

</details>


### [204] [Emergence of Exploration in Policy Gradient Reinforcement Learning via Retrying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00151)
*Soichiro Nishimori,Paavo Parmas,Sotetsu Koyamada,Tadashi Kozuno,Toshinori Kitamura,Shin Ishii,Yutaka Matsuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReMax目标，通过最大化M次采样中的期望最大回报来鼓励探索，并推导出其策略梯度形式，进而提出RePPO算法（PPO变体），无需显式探索奖励即可在MinAtar和Craftax基准上促进探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习中智能体从探索中获益的前提是能重复遇到相似状态；若无法重试，贪心策略即最优。本文旨在形式化这一直觉，提出一种无需显式探索奖励项即可自发产生随机探索的目标函数。

Method: 提出ReMax目标（评估策略在M次采样中的期望最大回报，并考虑回报不确定性）；推导ReMax的策略梯度公式；提出RePPO（PPO变体），将离散的重试次数M推广为连续参数m>0，从而实现对探索的精细控制。

Result: 在MinAtar和Craftax基准上，RePPO无需任何显式探索奖励即可有效促进探索行为。

Conclusion: 通过ReMax目标及其PPO变体RePPO，证明了随机探索可以作为优化目标的涌现属性出现，无需依赖传统的探索奖励项。

Abstract: In reinforcement learning (RL), agents benefit from exploration only because they repeatedly encounter similar states: trying different actions can improve performance or reduce uncertainty; without such retries, a greedy policy is optimal. We formalize this intuition with ReMax, an objective that evaluates a policy by the expected maximum return over $M$ samples, where $M$ is a positive integer, while accounting for return uncertainty. Optimizing this objective induces stochastic exploration as an emergent property, without explicit bonus terms. For efficient policy optimization, we derive a new policy-gradient formulation for ReMax and introduce ReMax PPO (RePPO), a PPO variant that optimizes ReMax while generalizing the discrete retry count $M$ to a continuous parameter $m > 0$, enabling fine-grained control of exploration. Empirically, RePPO promotes exploration, without any explicit exploration bonuses, on the MinAtar and Craftax benchmarks.

</details>


### [205] [ChurnNet: A Optimized Modern AI for Churn Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00169)
*Syed Saad Saif,Giulio Maggiore,Paolo Russo,Damiano Distante*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究评估了传统机器学习方法（随机森林、XGBoost、支持向量机）与统一多任务时序模型在客户流失预测任务上的表现，发现传统方法在预测性能、数据效率和计算资源需求方面仍优于先进的时序模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零售商面临客户流失加剧的挑战，准确的流失预测有助于驱动个性化营销活动并减少客户 attrition，因此需要评估不同方法在流失预测任务中的有效性。

Method: 将传统机器学习技术（随机森林、XGBoost、支持向量机）与统一多任务时序模型（Unified Multi-Task Time Series Model）进行对比，在多个数据集和多种流失标记技术下进行二元时间序列分类任务的评估。

Result: 尽管统一多任务时序模型能够建模复杂的时序动态和变量间关系，但传统方法在预测性能、数据效率和训练部署的计算资源需求方面仍优于该先进模型，且该结论在多个数据集和多种流失标记技术下保持一致。

Conclusion: 对于客户流失预测任务，传统机器学习方法在综合表现上依然优于复杂的多任务时序模型，研究者与实践者在选择方法时应考虑任务特性而非一味追求模型复杂度。

Abstract: Increased competition and the growing similarity of products and services offered by retailers have lowered the barriers for customers to switch to competitors. Accurate churn prediction can be a valuable tool for driving effective personalized marketing campaigns and helping to reduce customer attrition. This study evaluates the performance of traditional machine learning techniques, namely, Random Forests, XGBoost, and Support Vector Machines, and compares them with the Unified Multi-Task Time Series Model for churn prediction, a binary time-series classification task. Despite the strong capacity of the latter to model complex temporal dynamics and inter-variable relationships, our results indicate that for churn prediction, conventional methods can still outperform it in terms of predictive performance, data efficiency, and computational resource requirements for training and deployment. These findings are consistent across multiple datasets and various churn labeling techniques.

</details>


### [206] [Beyond Augmentation: Score-Guided Pathological Prior for EEG-based Depression Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00180)
*Xiaojing Chen,Jingqi Cheng,Xu Zhao,Wan Jiang,Jingjing Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无需数据增强的Score-Guided Classification (SGC)框架，通过无监督生成网络建模样本的异常度作为病理先验，与深度特征融合指导分类边界，并设计跨通道空间适配模块解决多中心数据集通道不匹配问题，在"零数据增强"和"零样本合成成本"下实现高效抑郁症检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于深度学习的EEG抑郁症检测受限于小样本困境，现有生成式数据增强方法计算开销大且引入合成噪声模糊分类边界，亟需突破"数据量优先"的惯例。

Method: 提出SGC框架，包含：(1) 利用无监督生成网络（扩散模型）建模样本的结构与统计异常度作为"病理先验"；(2) 对该先验进行鲁棒归一化后与深度特征表示显式融合，引导分类决策边界；(3) 设计Cross-Channel Spatial Adaptation模块，通过空间映射机制处理多中心数据集中的通道不匹配问题。

Result: 在Mumtaz2016和高密度MODMA数据集上，在零数据增强和零样本合成成本设置下验证了方法的有效性和出色的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 提出了一种无需数据增强的新范式，证明通过样本异常度建模作为先验可有效替代传统数据增强策略，同时解决了跨数据集通道异构性问题。

Abstract: Deep learning-based Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) detection using Electroencephalography (EEG) is fundamentally constrained by the "small-sample dilemma." Prevailing generative data augmentation methods not only incur heavy computational overhead but also risk introducing synthetic noise, thereby blurring classification boundaries. To challenge the traditional "data quantity first" convention, we propose a novel framework "Beyond Augmentation": Score-Guided Classification (SGC). SGC does not synthesize pseudo-samples; instead, it utilizes an unsupervised generative network architecture to model the structural and statistical anomaly degrees of samples, serving as the core "Pathological Prior". This prior, after robust normalization, is explicitly fused with deep feature representations, thereby precisely guiding the classifier's decision boundary. Furthermore, to dynamically adapt to varying channel configurations, we propose a Cross-Channel Spatial Adaptation module, utilizing a spatial mapping mechanism to effectively resolve the hardware heterogeneity of mismatched channels in multi-center datasets. Extensive experiments on the Mumtaz2016 and high-density MODMA datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and exceptional generalizability of our method under the challenging "zero data augmentation" setting and at "zero sample synthesis cost".
  Keywords: Electroencephalography (EEG), Depression Detection, Anomaly Score, Diffusion Models, Few-Shot Learning

</details>


### [207] [Agentic Transformers Provably Learn to Search via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00183)
*Tong Yang,Yu Huang,Yingbin Liang,Yuejie Chi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于Transformer的策略如何通过强化学习训练动态获得树搜索能力，在随机k叉树环境中，策略梯度训练下涌现出随机深度优先搜索（DFS）机制，且表现出深度泛化和不平衡目标分布下的优先级排序能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缺乏对Transformer策略如何从强化学习训练动态中获得搜索能力的理论理解。

Method: 在随机k叉树环境中，构建双头Transformer实现随机DFS；使用策略梯度在深度课程下训练，分析训练动态；研究不平衡目标分布下折扣因子的影响。

Result: DFS机制从稀疏强化反馈中分阶段涌现，无需专家示范；策略在深度1和2树上训练后能泛化到更深的全树；折扣回报导致优先搜索高概率分支的排序DFS策略。

Conclusion: 识别了Transformer搜索的机械化范式：注意力头通过RL训练专门化并协作，从上下文中提取决策相关轨迹并转化为智能体动作选择。

Abstract: Tree search is a central abstraction behind many language-agent reasoning and decision-making tasks: agents must explore actions, remember failures, and backtrack toward promising alternatives. Yet, we lack a theoretical understanding of how transformer-based policies acquire such search capabilities from the training dynamics of reinforcement learning (RL). We study this question in a stochastic $k$-ary tree environment, where an agentic transformer observes only its trajectory history through interaction and receives a terminal reward for reaching a hidden leaf goal node. We first construct a two-head transformer that implements randomized depth-first search (DFS): one head tracks previous actions, while the other detects failure outcomes and triggers backtracking. We then analyze the training dynamics of policy gradient under a depth-wise curriculum, showing that this same DFS mechanism emerges in stages from sparse reinforcement feedback without expert demonstrations. The resulting policy exhibits depth generalization: after training only on depth-$1$ and depth-$2$ trees, it succeeds on deeper full trees. We further show that, under imbalanced goal distributions, discounting the return leads to a ranked DFS policy that prioritizes higher-probability branches. Overall, our results identify a mechanistic normal form for transformer-based search, in which attention heads specialize and cooperate to extract decision-relevant traces from context and convert them into agentic action selection via RL training.

</details>


### [208] [AI-Guided Design and Optimization of Graphite-Based Anodes via Iterative Experimental Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00187)
*Qian Du,Mark M. Sullivan,James E. Saal,Florian Huber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出了一种迭代式AI引导工作流，通过多目标逆向设计优化石墨负极配方，将制造成功率提升至100%，高容量电池比例从28.4%提升至84.8%，容量保持率从42.1%提升至97.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业电池电极制造数据常存在噪声大、不完整等问题，传统方法难以从这类数据中高效优化配方和工艺，亟需一种能够处理不完美数据并实现快速、可重复优化的工作流。

Method: 基于Citrine平台实现AI/ML引导的多目标逆向设计，通过迭代式顺序学习，从不完整、噪声大的初始数据集出发构建代理模型，逐步添加可行性标签和边界条件失效数据，快速收敛到可制造、高性能的配方。

Result: 电池制造可靠性提升至100%成功生产；容量≥350 mAh g⁻¹的电池比例从28.4%升至84.8%；容量保持率从42.1%提升至97.3%。

Conclusion: 结构化的、反馈驱动的AI工作流能够将不完美的工业数据转化为可操作的指导，实现更快、更可重复的电池电极制造优化。

Abstract: This study presents an iterative AI-guided workflow that accelerates graphite-based anode development by improving both formulation feasibility and process robustness. Sequential learning via AI/ML-guided multiobjective inverse design for anode optimization was implemented using the Citrine Platform. Starting from a noisy, incomplete dataset, the Citrine Platform was used to generate early surrogate models, which despite low predictive certainty highlighted missing process constraints. By iteratively adding feasibility labels and boundary condition failures, the workflow rapidly converged toward manufacturable, higher-performing formulations. Fabrication reliability improved from frequent process failures to 100% successful cell production, while the fraction of cells delivering $\geq$ 350 mAh g$^{-1}$ increased from 28.4% to 84.8%, with capacity retention rising from 42.1% to 97.3%. These results demonstrate that structured, feedback-driven AI workflows can transform imperfect industrial data into actionable guidance, enabling faster, more reproducible optimization of battery electrode manufacturing.

</details>


### [209] [Learning to Construct Practical Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00189)
*Aditya Kumar,Zhihan Lei,Jerry Yan,Joshua W. Momo,Lauhitya Reddy,Rafael Enrique Cabrera Jimenez,Cassandra A. Cohen,Arthur Kajiyama,William W. Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于设计和优化实用化智能体系统的原则性方法，通过定义在受限上下文中递归调用LLM的"伪工具"来增强模块化，并验证了手工构建的固定工作流相比动态规划工作流更便宜、更准确，同时提出了针对伪工具和固定工作流的学习方法，以及多目标优化技术来联合优化成本和响应质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产环境中的智能体系统更关注简洁性、可控性和推理成本的可预测性，而现有研究多集中于自动化设计优化，忽视了实际部署中的这些关键需求。

Method: 提出了一种基于"伪工具"（在受限上下文上递归调用LLM）的智能体框架来强制执行模块化；手工构建固定工作流与动态规划工作流进行对比；提出了针对伪工具和固定工作流的学习方法；利用框架的模块化特性应用多目标优化方法联合优化成本和响应质量。

Result: 手工构建的固定工作流相比动态规划工作流通常更便宜且更准确；提出的学习方法在多个任务上通常优于手工设计的智能体；多目标优化方法能够有效联合优化成本和响应质量并融合多个学习系统的结果。

Conclusion: 实用化智能体系统设计应优先考虑模块化、固定工作流和成本可控性，所提出的框架和学习方法可在保证性能的同时满足生产环境对简洁性和可预测性的需求。

Abstract: Automated design and optimization of agentic LLM-based systems leads to sophisticated systems that substantially improve result quality over off-the-shelf agentic patterns. However, studies of fielded agentic systems show that production systems focus much more on issues such as simplicity, controllability, and predictability of inference costs. In this paper we propose principled approaches to designing and optimizing practical agentic systems. We describe an agent framework that enables designers to enforce modularity in agentic systems, by defining "pseudo-tools" that call LLMs recursively on a restricted context. Using this framework we hand-engineer agents for a diverse set of tasks, and show that relative to dynamically-planned workflows, hand-constructed fixed workflows are generally cheaper and more accurate. We then propose novel learning methods for the agentic components required by this framework, namely pseudo-tools and fixed workflows. These learning methods generally outperform hand-engineered agents. We also exploit the modularity of the framework to apply multi-objective optimization methods to jointly optimize cost and response quality and blend the results of multiple learning systems.

</details>


### [210] [BAGEN: Are LLM Agents Budget-Aware?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00198)
*Yuxiang Lin,Zihan Wang,Mengyang Liu,Yuxuan Shan,Longju Bai,Junyao Zhang,Xing Jin,Boshan Chen,Jinyan Su,Xingyao Wang,Jiaxin Pei,Manling Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出预算感知智能体（BAGEN）概念，将预算从被动度量变为主动控制信号。通过定义内外部预算、形式化渐进区间估计方法，并在多个环境和前沿模型上实验发现：强模型预算感知能力弱（r=0.35）、普遍过度乐观、早期停止可节省28-64% token，但精确区间校准仍具挑战（覆盖度最高47%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体仅在执行后衡量成本，缺乏预算的主动控制能力。预算应作为执行过程中的主动控制信号，而非事后的被动成本度量。

Method: 系统定义内部预算（agent计算）和外部预算（agent行动）两类预算；将预算感知形式化为渐进区间估计——每步预测剩余预算的上下界，在完成概率低时发出警报；采用rollout-replay协议进行评分。

Result: 在四个环境和五个前沿模型上发现：（1）强模型与预算感知能力相关性弱（r=0.35）；（2）前沿模型普遍过度乐观，在不可能成功的任务上继续消耗资源；（3）预算感知信号可训练，早期停止节省28-64% token，SFT+RL强化了早期停止和警报行为；（4）精确区间校准仍困难，SFT+RL后区间覆盖率最高仅47%。

Conclusion: 预算感知是独立于模型能力的重要维度，可通过训练提升，但精确的区间校准仍是开放挑战。

Abstract: While agents are increasingly spending more resources, today agent cost is mostly measured only after execution. A Budget-Aware Agent (BAGEN) should treat budget as an active control signal, rather than a passive cost metric. We first systematically define budget estimation as internal budgets (from agent computation) and external budgets (from agent actions). We then formalize budget-awareness as progressive interval estimation: at each step of a plan, an agent should predict an upper and lower bound on remaining budget, and alert when completion is unlikely. Scoring with a rollout-replay protocol, we find consistent failure patterns on four environments and five frontier agents: (1) strong agents do not necessarily have strong budget-awareness, with correlation r=0.35. (2) frontier models are consistently over-optimistic, continue spending on tasks that are unlikely to succeed, instead of alerting the user early. (3) budget-aware signal is actionable and trainable. Early stop saves 28-64% tokens on failed trajectories, and SFT+RL strengthens early stop and alert behavior. (4) precise interval calibration remains challenging, with interval coverage capping at 47% after SFT+RL. Project page: https://ragen-ai.github.io/bagen/

</details>


### [211] [From Rashomon Theory to PRAXIS: Efficient Decision Tree Rashomon Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00202)
*Zakk Heile,Hayden McTavish,Varun Babbar,Margo Seltzer,Cynthia Rudin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRAXIS是一种高效近似Rashomon集合的算法，相比完整计算实现了运行时和内存使用上数量级的提升，并能恢复几乎完整的Rashomon集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准机器学习管道通常存在许多近似最优模型（Rashomon集），这些集合对不确定性感知和稳健决策具有重要意义，但计算Rashomon集（即使是简单可解释模型类如稀疏决策树）需要巨大的内存和运行时资源。

Method: 提出PRAXIS算法，用于近似Rashomon集合，在运行时和内存使用上实现数量级的改进。

Result: PRAXIS能够定期恢复几乎完整的完整Rashomon集，并允许研究人员和从业者以可扩展的方式对真实世界数据集的Rashomon集进行建模。

Conclusion: PRAXIS解决了Rashomon集计算的可扩展性瓶颈，使不确定性感知的稳健决策在实际应用中成为可能。

Abstract: Standard machine learning pipelines often admit many near-optimal models. These "Rashomon sets" pose a range of challenges and opportunities for uncertainty-aware, robust decision making. They allow users to incorporate domain knowledge and preferences that would otherwise be difficult to specify directly in an objective, and they quantify diversity among valid models for a given training dataset and objective function. However, computation of Rashomon sets, even for simple, interpretable model classes such as sparse decision trees, continues to require immense memory and runtime resources. We present PRAXIS, an algorithm to approximate this Rashomon set with orders of magnitude improvement in runtime and memory usage. We validate that PRAXIS regularly recovers almost all of the full Rashomon set. PRAXIS allows researchers and practitioners to scalably model the Rashomon set for real-world datasets. Code for PRAXIS is available at https://github.com/zakk-h/PRAXIS

</details>


### [212] [Quantized Reasoning Models Think They Need to Think Longer, but They Do Not](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00206)
*Sanae Lotfi,Polina Kirichenko,Steven Li,Zechun Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究发现，对推理模型进行激进的后训练量化（PTQ）会降低准确率、延长思维链（CoT）长度，并在高达52%的失败案例中导致模型在中间步骤得出正确答案但未作为最终输出。问题根源在于量化模型在高熵位置过度采样"wait"、"but"等过度思考标记。通过引入免训练的logit惩罚，可将CoT长度减少12-23%，同时保持或提升准确率，并将过度思考错误减少高达58%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练量化被广泛用于高效部署大语言模型，但其对推理模型（如数学、编程、科学问答任务）的影响尚未被充分理解，特别是量化如何影响模型的推理过程和准确性。

Method: 1) 测量量化模型与全精度模型在token级别的KL散度，识别高分歧位置；2) 分析高KL散度位置与高next-token熵的关联；3) 对一组精心挑选的过度思考标记（如"wait"、"but"、"alternatively"）引入免训练的logit惩罚。

Result: 1) 激进PTQ降低准确率的同时延长CoT长度；2) 高达52%的量化模型失败案例中，模型在中间推理步骤已得出正确答案但未作为最终输出；3) 高KL散度位置与高next-token熵强相关，且量化模型在这些位置过度采样过度思考标记；4) 对过度思考标记施加logit惩罚可将CoT长度减少12-23%，同时保持或提升准确率；5) 过度思考错误减少高达58%。

Conclusion: 量化导致的"过度思考"（overthinking）是推理性能下降的关键机制，通过简单的免训练logit惩罚即可有效缓解，在准确率与推理成本之间取得更优的Pareto前沿。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to deploy large language models efficiently, but its effect on reasoning models is not well understood. Across math, coding, and science QA, we find that aggressive PTQ reduces accuracy while increasing chain-of-thought (CoT) length. Surprisingly, we show that in up to 52% of the quantized models' failures, models reach the right answer in intermediate reasoning steps but do not output it as a final answer. To understand why quantization leads to this increase in overthinking errors, we measure the token-level KL divergence between quantized and full-precision output distributions. Positions with high KL divergence correlate strongly with high next-token entropy, and at these positions quantized models disproportionately sample overthinking markers such as "wait", "but", and "alternatively". We show that simply introducing a training-free logit penalty on a curated set of overthinking markers can reduce CoT length by 12--23% while preserving or improving accuracy across 5 models (1.5B-32B parameters), 3 quantization methods, and 5 benchmarks, yielding a favorable Pareto frontier of accuracy against reasoning cost compared to penalizing other token sets. Overthinking errors produced by quantized models are particularly reduced by up to 58%.

</details>


### [213] [LithoGRPO: Fast Inverse Lithography via GRPO Reinforced Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00228)
*Yao Lai,Xuyuan Xiong,Zeyue Xue,Guojin Chen,Jing Wang,Xihui Liu,Rui Zhang,Robert Mullins,Bei Yu,Ping Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LithoGRPO 首次将流匹配与GRPO强化学习相结合用于逆光刻技术，通过物理驱动的奖励函数和快速掩模可制造性评估算法，在掩模优化中实现了超越现有优化方法和学习方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ILT依赖显式物理指标评估掩模，限制了现有生成模型的应用；现有方法无法在复杂工艺约束下高效生成多样化掩模。

Method: 将流匹配生成范式与GRPO强化学习微调相结合；提出快速shot计数算法（130倍加速）用于可制造性评估；利用ILT中物理驱动的奖励函数引导强化学习优化。

Result: 在掩模优化任务上取得了超越基于优化的方法和基于学习的方法的性能；快速shot计数算法在保持掩模排序准确性的同时实现130倍以上加速。

Conclusion: 首次统一了流匹配与强化学习用于掩模优化，验证了物理奖励驱动的RL在ILT中的有效性，在性能和效率上均达到最优。

Abstract: In semiconductor manufacturing, lithography projects circuit layouts onto silicon wafers through an optical mask. As circuit features shrink below the wavelength of light, optical diffraction causes the printed patterns to deviate from their intended layouts. Inverse Lithography Technology (ILT) addresses this challenge by generating optimized masks that enhance the fidelity of pattern transfer onto wafers. While ILT resembles an image synthesis task, its reliance on explicit physical metrics for mask evaluation limits the applicability of existing generative models. We introduce LithoGRPO, an ILT framework that integrates the flow-matching paradigm with GRPO-based reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning, enabling efficient exploration of diverse masks for a given target layout. Unlike purely generative or optimization-based approaches, RL in LithoGRPO exploits the explicitly defined, physics-based reward function of ILT, enabling optimization under complex, process-aware constraints. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first framework that unifies flow matching and RL for mask optimization. To improve RL sampling efficiency, we propose a fast shot-counting algorithm for manufacturability evaluation, achieving over 130x speedup while preserving the mask ranking of the traditional shot-count metric. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LithoGRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance over both optimization-based and learning-based methods, while maintaining efficient mask generation.

</details>


### [214] [A Pre-Training Analogue of Grokking in Language Models: Tracing Delayed Grammatical Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00230)
*Sherin Muckatira,Namrata Shivagunde,Vijeta Deshpande,Anna Rumshisky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于曝光度的框架，用于研究LLM预训练中的类grokking延迟泛化现象，并在BLiMP最小对数据集上观察到五种语法现象的延迟泛化，发现泛化后语法概念向量更具预测性且占据更高维子空间，注意力集中在少数头部。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Grokking现象已在监督设置中被研究，但LLM预训练涉及无标注语料上的下一个词预测，数据重复有限且无显式训练/验证划分。本文旨在弥合这一差距，提出一种能在LLM预训练中研究类grokking动态的框架。

Method: 提出基于曝光度的框架：对每个BLiMP最小对识别关键短语（捕捉语法对比和现象相关上下文的最小连续跨度），根据关键短语是否出现在预训练窗口中将样本划分为代理训练集和代理验证集。在五种语法现象上分析预训练检查点。

Result: 观察到五种语法现象均出现延迟泛化；泛化后语法概念向量对语法可接受性的预测性更强且占据更高维子空间；关键token到相关上下文token的注意力集中在少数头部。

Conclusion: 提出的曝光度框架能有效将grokking研究扩展到LLM预训练场景，揭示了预训练中延迟泛化的动态特性及其神经表征和注意力机制层面的变化。

Abstract: Grokking, the phenomenon in which neural networks generalize long after fitting their training data, has been studied in supervised settings on many epochs. LLM pre-training instead involves next-token prediction over an unlabeled corpus, with limited data repetition and no explicit train/validation split. To address this, we propose an exposure-based framework that enables the study of grokking-like dynamics during LLM pre-training. We ground our evaluation in BLiMP minimal pairs, which provide controlled grammatical contrasts. For every BLiMP minimal pair, we identify a critical phrase, the smallest continuous span that captures the grammatical contrast and the phenomenon-relevant context. Examples whose critical phrase appears in the pre-training window are assigned to the proxy-train split; the remaining examples are assigned to the proxy-validation split. Across five grammatical phenomena, we observe delayed generalization. Analyzing pre-training checkpoints before and after generalization shows that grammatical concept vectors become more predictive of grammatical acceptability and occupy a higher-dimensional subspace after generalization. We also find that attention from the critical token to the relevant context token is concentrated in a small number of heads.

</details>


### [215] [InfoAtlas: A Foundation Model for Zero-Shot Statistical Dependence Estimate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00241)
*Zhengyang Hu,Yanzhi Chen,Hanxiang Ren,Qunsong Zeng,Youyi Zheng,Adrian Weller,Kaibin Huang,Yanchao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: InfoAtlas是一种类似基础模型的架构，通过在大规模合成数据上预训练，将互信息估计从迭代优化问题转化为单次前向推理任务，在保持SOTA精度的同时实现100倍加速，并能灵活处理不同维度和样本量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经互信息估计器需要对每个新数据集进行昂贵的迭代优化，无法满足实时应用需求，亟需一种高效、无需逐数据集训练的互信息估计方法。

Method: 提出InfoAtlas基础模型架构，在包含丰富依赖模式的大规模合成数据上预训练，学习识别多样化的依赖结构并直接从数据集预测互信息，实现单次前向传播即可完成估计。

Result: InfoAtlas在精度上匹配现有最先进神经估计器，同时实现100倍加速；单个统一模型能灵活处理不同维度和样本量；能有效泛化到复杂的真实场景。

Conclusion: 通过将互信息估计重构为推理任务，InfoAtlas为实时依赖分析建立了基础，消除了传统方法在每个新数据集上迭代优化的瓶颈。

Abstract: Measuring statistical dependency between high-dimensional random variables is a fundamental task in data science and machine learning. Neural mutual information (MI) estimators offer a promising avenue, but they typically require costly iterative optimization for each new dataset, making them impractical for real-time applications. We present InfoAtlas, a foundation model-like architecture that eliminates this bottleneck by directly inferring MI in a single forward pass. Pretrained on large-scale synthetic data with rich dependence patterns, InfoAtlas learns to identify diverse dependence structures and predict MI directly from the dataset. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that InfoAtlas matches state-of-the-art neural estimators in accuracy while achieving $100\times$ speedup, can flexibly handle varying dimensions and sample sizes through a single unified model, and generalizes effectively to complex, real-world scenarios. By reformulating MI estimation as an inference task, InfoAtlas establishes a foundation for real-time dependency analysis.

</details>


### [216] [ARCA: Adapter-Residual Credit Assignment When Token Signals Degenerate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00257)
*Rodney Lafuente-Mercado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了LoRA微调下强化学习信用分配的结构性失效问题（输出分布信号在归一化后退化），并提出基于适配器残差的轻量级信用分配方法ARCA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-RL的token级信用分配假设策略完全可训练，但实际中多采用LoRA等参数高效微调。这种分离隐藏了结构性问题：LoRA将策略限制在参考模型的低秩邻域内，导致基于输出分布差异的信用信号（如surprisal、熵减、策略散度）在轨迹内归一化后退化。

Method: 1) 形式化分析LoRA下信用信号的退化行为；2) 提出集中度诊断指标（权重基尼系数、有效token比率）量化退化程度；3) 提出ARCA方法：利用适配器自身隐藏状态残差||h^adapted_t - h^base_t||_2作为token显著性信号，而非依赖输出分布不确定性或偏移。

Result: 在MATH/Qwen3-1.7B GRPO实验中，ARCA展现出预测中的非退化中间区域信用分布，且在匹配的rollout预算下与rank匹配的基线保持竞争力。

Conclusion: ARCA作为一种轻量级替代方案，无需学习奖励模型、价值头或构建树，直接基于适配器实际改变模型的位置分配信用，有效避免了LoRA场景下传统信用信号的退化问题。

Abstract: Token-level credit assignment for language-model reinforcement learning is usually formulated as if the policy were fully trainable, while practical LLM-RL pipelines often rely on parameter-efficient fine-tuning, especially LoRA. We argue that this separation hides a structural failure mode. Under LoRA, the policy is restricted to a low-rank neighborhood of the reference model, so the per-token output-distribution differences used by common intrinsic credit signals, surprisal, entropy reduction, and policy divergence, can become degenerate after within-trajectory normalization, either approaching uniform weights or concentrating on a small set of task-agnostic positions. We formalize this behavior and propose measuring it directly with concentration diagnostics such as weight Gini and effective-token ratio. We then introduce \emph{Adapter-Residual Credit Assignment} (ARCA), a lightweight alternative that derives token salience from the adapter's own hidden-state residual, $\|h^{\text{adapted}}_t - h^{\text{base}}_t\|_2$.
